basic_info.description: Welcome to 274 Maynard Street, San Francisco. This beautiful and sunny 3 bedroom, 2 bath single family home with a garage is nestled between Portola and Excelsior, near McLaren Park. The main level includes 3 bedrooms, one of which can be flexibly used as an office or nursery. The garage level includes one-car parking, two bonus rooms for a home office/guest room and an exercise room,  an unwarranted second full bath (buyers to verify with the city), and a common area. The backyard oasis offers a sunny patio/deck, ideal for outdoor enjoyment and entertaining. Amenities include new exterior and interior paint, new flooring, dual-paned windows and sliding door, new stove and oven, new refrigerator, and much more! Conveniently located near shops and restaurants along Mission Street, BART, Highways 280 and 101, and McLaren Park.  Come tour this home!
